mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward SPX returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25pp over 1 month) signals aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25pp over 1 month, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (characterized by high industrial production and low unemployment), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates deteriorating consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 4.0%, a decline in RSAFS (over the past month) is followed by positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the 3-month change in INDPRO and 60-day forward SPX returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when PAYEMS declines by at least 50k and UNRATE rises by at least 0.1pp, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1.4 million units (HOUST < 1400.0), it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces economic growth and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1400.0.
